caption:
Every short video that holds attention follows the same 8 beats.

1. Hook: break the scroll in the first second
2. Lead: carry them to the 10-second mark
3. Body 1: deliver the first real piece of value
4. Open loop: end on a line they need answered
5. Body 2
6. Open loop
7. Body 3
8. CTA: ask your warmest viewers for one clear action

Two loops, three blocks of value, zero dead air.

Most videos die because they skip the lead or end every block with a period instead of a question. Fix those two and your watch time changes.
